parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the clock is made of plastic and forms the outer casing that holds all internal components together.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and protection for the internal mechanisms of the clock.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: The hour hand is a small aluminum pointer that indicates the hour on the clock face.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates slowly around the clock face to show the current hour.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the central axis once every 12 hours.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: The minute hand is a longer aluminum pointer that indicates the minutes on the clock face.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates around the clock face to show the current minute.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the central axis once every hour.

parts.name: Second Hand
parts.Basic_description: The second hand is a thin aluminum pointer that indicates the seconds on the clock face.
parts.Functional_description: It moves continuously or in steps to show the passing seconds.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the central axis once every 60 seconds.

parts.name: Surface
parts.Basic_description: The surface is the front face of the clock where the numbers and hands are displayed.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a readable background for the clock hands and may include printed numerals or markers.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Glass
parts.Basic_description: The glass covers the clock face, protecting it from dust and damage.
parts.Functional_description: It allows visibility of the clock face while shielding the internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed transparent cover and does not move during operation.
